errorPage.notFoundTitle: You have wandered into an uncharted zone
errorPage.notFoundText: This page does not exist or is no longer available. Try a search instead.
errorPage.serverText: The error has been reported to us. Please try again in a moment.

errors.VALIDATION_FAILED: Some fields are not valid. Check them and try again.
errors.FORBIDDEN: You are not allowed to do this.
errors.NOT_FOUND: This content does not exist or is no longer available.

offline.title: You're offline
offline.text: This page is not available offline. Pages you visited recently:

pwa.installText: Install Legendary Shots on your device to open it in one tap.
pwa.iosSteps: In Safari, tap Share, then Add to Home Screen.

consent.title: Your cookie choices
consent.text: We use essential cookies to run the site. With your permission, we'd also like to measure how features are used and show personalised ads that keep Legendary Shots free.
consent.analyticsDescription: PostHog (EU): pages visited and actions such as upload, like or share. Kept 12 months.

auth.turnstileUnavailable: The anti-bot check could not load. Reload the page and try again.

signup.title: Create account
signup.terms: I am at least 15 and accept the Terms and Privacy policy.
signup.note: We'll send a link to verify your email. You can publish once it's verified.
signup.inboxText: We've sent you an email. Open the link inside within 24 hours to verify your address and sign in.

waitlist.title: Join the waiting list
waitlist.text: During the beta, accounts are created by invitation. Leave your email and we'll let you know when Legendary Shots opens.
waitlist.consent: I agree to receive an email when the site opens.
waitlist.doneText: We'll email you when the site opens. Nothing else until then.

username.length: Your username must have 3 to 24 characters.
username.reserved: This username is reserved. Choose another one.
username.insult: This username is not allowed. Choose another one.

password.too_short: Your password must have at least 10 characters.
password.too_long: Your password must have at most 128 characters.
password.breached: This password appeared in a known data breach. Choose another one.

turnstileToken.failed: The anti-bot check failed. Try again.

signin.title: Sign in
signin.turnstileRequired: Several attempts failed. Confirm you are not a robot, then sign in again.

forgot.title: Reset your password
forgot.text: Enter your email. If an account exists, we'll send a reset link valid for 1 hour.
forgot.sent: Check your inbox: if this email is registered, the link is on its way.

reset.title: Choose a new password
reset.text: Your new password signs you out on every device, then signs you in here.
reset.expired: This link has expired. Links are valid for 1 hour.
reset.invalid: This link is not valid: it was already used or is incomplete.

verify.title: Verify your email
verify.expired: This link has expired. Links are valid for 24 hours.
verify.invalid: This link is not valid: it was already used or is incomplete.
verify.sent: New link sent. Check your inbox.
verify.signIn: Sign in to get a new link

confirmEmail.title: Confirm your new email
confirmEmail.done: Your new email is confirmed. Use it from now on to sign in.
confirmEmail.expired: This link has expired. Links are valid for 24 hours: ask for a new one in your settings.
confirmEmail.invalid: This link is not valid: it was already used, replaced by a newer one, or is incomplete.
confirmEmail.taken: This address is now used by another account. Choose another one in your settings.

oauth.failed: That sign-in did not work. Try again, or use your email.
oauth.linkNotice: Sign in with your password to link Google to your account.
oauth.completeText: One last step to create your account. Your username is public.
oauth.expired: This sign-in has expired or was already used. Start again.
oauth.emailTaken: An account already uses {email}. Sign in to it with your password to link Google: no new account is created.

avatar.title: Avatar
avatar.hint: JPEG, PNG or WebP. The centred square is kept, at least 128 × 128 px.
avatar.sent: Your new avatar is being checked: it replaces the current one once approved, and you will be notified.
avatar.small: This image is too small: the avatar needs at least {min} × {min} px.
avatar.unreadable: This file cannot be read as an image. Choose a JPEG, PNG or WebP.
avatar.failed: The image could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.

username.title: Username
username.hint: 3 to 24 characters: letters, digits, _ and -. You can change it once every 30 days.
username.saved: Username changed. Your former profile link redirects for 90 days.
username.wait: You can change your username once every 30 days: try again in {days} days.

profile.title: Profile

bio.label: Bio
bio.too_long: Your bio must have 300 characters or fewer.
bio.insult: Your bio contains a word that is not allowed.

profile.language: Language of the site and the emails

password.title: Password
password.saved: Password changed. Your other devices are signed out.
password.wrong: This is not your current password.
password.none: Your account has no password yet: set one with “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page.

linked.title: Linked accounts
linked.done: {provider} is no longer linked to your account.
linked.last: This is your only way to sign in: add a password with “Forgot password?” on the sign-in page, or link another account first.

email.title: Email
email.none: Your account has no email yet: add one to sign in with a password and receive our emails.
email.sent: Link sent to {email}: open it within 24 hours. Until then, your email stays the same.

social.title: Social networks
social.text: Your username only, for example luneblade for Twitch or {'@'}luneblade for YouTube; the full https:// address for your website. Leave a field empty to remove it.
social.format: This is not a valid {network} username.
social.website: Enter an https:// address, without an IP address or a link shortener, 200 characters at most.
social.insult: This contains a word that is not allowed.

profile.emptyOwn: You haven't published any capture yet
profile.emptyOwnText: Your published captures will show here, for everyone to see.

notifications.title: Quest log
notifications.empty: No new quests. Go capture something beautiful.

text.like: {actor} liked {title}. | {actor} and {others} other liked {title}. | {actor} and {others} others liked {title}.

moderation.pending_review: Your capture {title} is being reviewed by a moderator.
moderation.rejected: Your capture {title} was rejected by the automatic moderation (sensitive content). You can appeal within 6 months: see the Terms.
moderation.failed: Your capture {title} could not be processed. Please upload it again.

avatar.pending_review: Your new avatar is being reviewed by a moderator.
avatar.rejected: Your new avatar was rejected by moderation.
avatar.failed: Your new avatar could not be processed. Please try again.

contest.ending: A contest you entered ends soon.

prefs.title: Notification settings
prefs.moderation: Moderation decisions and quality tiers (always on)
prefs.grouped: Likes are grouped: “Ysolde and 23 others liked…” to avoid flooding your log.

home.description: World of Warcraft screenshots shared by their players: browse them by version, find the captures of the week, share yours.

hero.title: Azeroth, seen by its players.
hero.lead: Share your best captures, discover the community's, download them in full resolution.

gallery.title: {version} captures
gallery.description: Screenshots of {version} shared by the community, newest first.
gallery.emptyText: No capture of this version yet: share yours to open its gallery.

qualityHelp.title: Capture quality
qualityHelp.text: Like items in the game, every capture earns a quality from the community's likes. It levels up on its own.
qualityHelp.note: Thresholds may change as the community grows.

photo.title: {title} — {version}
photo.description: {title}, a {version} screenshot captured by {author} on Legendary Shots.

captures.title: My captures
captures.emptyText: Your uploads appear here, with their status, as soon as they are sent.

hint.processing: Cleaning the file and making its sizes. It only takes a moment.
hint.pending_review: A moderator checks it before it goes online. Only you can see it.
hint.rejected: Refused by the moderation. You can appeal within 6 months: see the Terms.
hint.hidden: Hidden by a moderator. Only you can see it.
hint.failed: This file could not be processed. Please upload it again.

delete.label: Delete « {title} »
delete.title: Delete this capture?
delete.confirm: « {title} » will disappear everywhere on the site. This cannot be undone.

upload.title: Upload a capture
upload.acceptedText: Your capture is being checked by our moderation, usually in under a minute. You'll get a notification when it's live.

file.title: Your file
file.accepted: Accepted: JPEG, PNG, WebP, TGA · max 20 MB (larger files are converted in your browser) · up to 8K (7680 px) · 20 uploads per day.

problem.type: This format is not accepted: choose a JPEG, PNG, WebP or TGA file.
problem.empty: This file is empty or could not be read as an image.
problem.dimensions: The long side must be between 640 and 7680 px, and the image at most 8K (33.2 Mpx).
problem.memory: Convert this file on a computer: this device ran out of memory.
problem.failed: This file could not be converted. Try another export of the capture.

file.converting: Converting in your browser… This can take a few seconds for an 8K capture.

converted.png: ✓ Format TGA, converted to lossless PNG
converted.webp: ✓ Over 20 MB, converted to lossless WebP

file.lossy: Even lossless, this file stays over 20 MB: it was converted to JPEG quality 95, which loses a little detail.

fields.title: Title
fields.zoneHint: EN or FR name. Not listed? Type it: it will be reviewed.
fields.caption: Caption
fields.captionHint: Shown in yellow italics, like item flavor text.
fields.altHint: What the capture shows, for screen readers. By default: its title, zone and author.

tags.label: Tags
tags.charset: Letters, digits, spaces and hyphens only.

upload.consent: I took this capture myself and accept the community rules. Others can download it for personal use.
upload.failed: The file could not be sent. Check your connection and try again.
upload.limited: You reached 20 uploads for today. Next one possible at {time}.

errors.insult: This text contains a word that is not allowed.
errors.unknown: Choose a value from the list.
errors.charset: Letters, digits, spaces and hyphens only.

upload.verify: Verify your email to post captures. We sent you a link when you signed up; you can get a new one.

preview.title: Live preview
preview.use: Use: download the original as a wallpaper.
preview.quality: Every capture starts as Poor and levels up with likes.

focal.title: Focal point
focal.hint: Touch the image where the subject is: the crops of the gallery keep it in view. By default, the centre.
